The '''V-series droid supervisor''' was a model of [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]]. A relaunch of the [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]] marketed towards the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], its performance was unimpressive and the model was a financial failure.

==Characteristics==
A model of [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]], the V-series had similar attributes to its precursor, the [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]], but also featured a more tolerable personality.<ref name="A&EG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> It lacked the [[MDF motivator]] that was installed in many first-generation EVs, which had increased efficiency at the cost of higher rates of attrition among the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] they oversaw.<ref name="TEGtD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Despite being equipped with an augmented monitor system,<ref name="TVD" /> the V-series' performance was unimpressive by comparison.<ref name="TEGtD" />

==History==
Manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]],<ref name="TNEGtD" /> the V-series droid supervisor<ref name="TVD" /> was a relaunch of the EV-series marketed towards the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="TNEGtD" /> However, its performance was considered unimpressive<ref name="TEGtD" /> and the model failed spectacularly,<ref name="TNEGtD" /> becoming a financial failure for MerenData.<ref name="TEGtD" />
